title: First airplane flight and the free meal
summary: Monk declined dinner on the plane because he thought he had to pay.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Then you did get on the plane...and go.

I got on the plane as if...like I was riding planes every day back and forth to work. I got on that plane and a couple of funny things happened. I guess I can use it as a humor piece here, because I had rode a train, I had rode a bus before; and I remembered being on this train coming from Columbus. It had a dining car and when you go in the dining care, or whatever, you got to buy your food. And you ride a bus, when you stop you go get a, whatever you get...And when I got on the plane I know, you're taking a ride to California. A pretty long ride, right. And I was thinking, wow, I didn't prepare, what do you do? I need food...
And so you didn't know...how they did it?

...I just didn't know. I wasn't prepared. And when the lady came out and asked, 'Would you care for lunch?' or care for dinner, I think it was. 'Dinner? Are you having dinner?' I said, 'No, thanks.' Because, you see, I didn't have the money for it. And I was just saying, 'Oh, no, thanks, I don't care for any dinner.' I thought you had to pay for it. Isn't that wild?

And the guys sitting next to me was just eating away, eating away. And everybody...When they brought the tray to eat, and the food was...and I was hungry, really hungry. And I kept noticing, and I didn't see the guy pay her or anything, and I thought, 'Could this be possible?' Anyhow, I lived through that.
